# Trends

```{python}
#| include: false
days = q("""
  select 
    max(date_day) as last_day,
    max(date_day) filter (
      where date_day < (select max(date_day) from marts.fct_player_trends_daily)
    ) as latest_day
  from marts.fct_player_trends_daily
""")
last_day, latest_day = days.last_day[0], days.latest_day[0]
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Daily average players, top six games by 7-day average, with the 7-day average"
small_multiples(
  q("""
    select t.date_day, g.app_name, t.avg_player_count, t.avg_player_count_7d, t.observed_hours
    from marts.fct_player_trends_daily t
    join marts.game_leaderboard g using (app_id)
    where g.rank_7d <= 6
      and t.date_day < (select max(date_day) from marts.fct_player_trends_daily)
    order by g.rank_7d, t.date_day
  """),
  x="date_day",
  ys=["avg_player_count", "avg_player_count_7d"],
  names=["Daily average", "7-day average"],
  facet="app_name",
  hours="observed_hours",
)
```

## Row

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Biggest moves from the previous day"
moves = q(f"""
  (
    select g.app_name, t.avg_player_count_change_rate as change_rate
    from marts.fct_player_trends_daily t
    join marts.dim_game g using (app_id)
    where t.date_day = '{latest_day}' and t.avg_player_count_change_rate is not null
    order by t.avg_player_count_change_rate desc
    limit 6
  )
  union all
  (
    select g.app_name, t.avg_player_count_change_rate
    from marts.fct_player_trends_daily t
    join marts.dim_game g using (app_id)
    where t.date_day = '{latest_day}' and t.avg_player_count_change_rate is not null
    order by t.avg_player_count_change_rate asc
    limit 6
  )
  order by change_rate desc
""")
diverging_bars(moves, value="change_rate", label="app_name")
```

::: {.card fill="false"}
Moves compare `{python} f"{latest_day:%Y-%m-%d}"` with the day before;
`{python} f"{last_day:%Y-%m-%d}"` is still in progress and left out. Hover shows each day's
observed hours.
:::

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Players across all tracked games by hour of day, last seven complete days (UTC)"
bars(
  q("""
    with days as (
      select date_day
      from marts.fct_player_counts_daily
      group by date_day
      having max(observed_hours) = 24
      order by date_day desc
      limit 7
    ),
    totals as (
      select c.logical_hour, c.hour_of_day, sum(c.player_count) as players
      from marts.fct_player_counts c
      join days using (date_day)
      group by 1, 2
    )
    select hour_of_day, avg(players) as players
    from totals
    group by hour_of_day
    order by hour_of_day
  """),
  x="hour_of_day",
  y="players",
  unit="players",
)
```
